svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Celadon F$NY mark, v8
svg.desc: A soft-rounded celadon local tag containing the literal F$NY initials, with the S replaced by a dollar sign. A small zero is placed inside the main tag body centered above the F$NY initials. Shape and internal type share a minus-eight-degree angle. Right and bottom point-and-hole motifs remain exact reflected twins. Original, unadopted vector concept with transparent surroundings and editable text.
